description: Phase 5. Olivine idle spin-down ports from phase-a (opt-in idle_timeout worker param, client-reads-only activity, snapshot-before-spin-down, {:shutdown, :idle} exit, foreman self-removal). Distributor: idle DOWN -> placeholder entry committed, NO eager re-recruit; revival on demand. Re-adoption residue only: the durable materializers/ family already feeds bootstrap re-adoption, so the distributor re-adopts only tags bootstrap left ABSENT (one-shot per sweep, pending-demand reservation, never remove a pre-existing worker).
title: Idle spin-down + re-adoption residue
